editorial.name: Beside
editorial.descriptionZh: Beside 把电话、AI 前台、排期、CRM、评价管理、建站和投放打包成一套给本地小生意的运营系统。
editorial.takeawayZh: 看 8 个产品怎么收进一个搜索框开场
editorial.noteZh: 首屏白底，画了一条虚线拱门，正中一枚 Chases every lead 的小胶囊，大标题 The AI operating system that runs your local business，副题写 Make your business visible to new customers, convert every lead, and keep your regulars coming back.。标题下面直接是一个搜索框，placeholder 是 Your business name，右边绿色按钮 Run free audit，下面还有 Searching near your city 与 Search website instead 两个小切换。导航 Products / Industries / Integrations / Pricing / Customers / Resources，Products 下拉里排着 Phone、AI Receptionist、Scheduling、CRM、Reviews Manager、Website Builder、Ads Manager，Industries 则是 Realtors、Plumbers、HVAC、Hair salons、Insurance。正文写 Three jobs stand between you and your craft.，并用 21,000+ paying businesses 与一位钢琴行老板 Michael Chudner 的评价做背书。
editorial.pricing: unknown（导航有 Pricing，首页只给 Run free audit 与 21,000+ paying businesses）

reasons.statement: 这是 Beside 自家产品官网，从 saaslandingpage.com 收进候选池；交付的是按月订阅的一整套本地生意运营系统，首屏只给免费审计工具与 Get started，属产品与公司官网。
拿不准：AI Receptionist、CRM、Website Builder 单拎出来都能对着别的目录小类，但站上是打包售卖的一件产品，首页也不分别呈现可拿走的产物，故整体按产品官网归档。

pages.title: Beside: The AI operating system that runs your local business
pages.selectionRationale: 本条目采集于 2026-09-15 的首屏实测；手记描述的就是这一屏。

shot.alt: Beside 首屏：The AI operating system that runs your local business

facts.evidence: 导航有 Pricing，首页只写 21,000+ paying businesses already run on Beside，没有档位；Run free audit 是免费工具而不是免费套餐。

facts.value: Phone、AI Receptionist、Scheduling、CRM、Reviews Manager、Website Builder、Ads Manager 七条产品线
facts.evidence: 首屏正文 Products 段的逐条说明与导航下拉，例如 CRM 那条写 The call writes the customer record.。
导航 Industries 一栏与 /industries/realtors、/industries/plumbers 等路径。

facts.value: 接 HubSpot、Attio、Google Contacts、Google Sheets、Microsoft Teams、Follow Up Boss
facts.evidence: Integrates with your tools 区块与 /integration/attio、/integration/hubspot 等路径。
